items.title: Verizon Stock Rises After Earnings as Turnaround Plan Gathers Pace
items.summary: Verizon  stock was rising on Friday after the wireless carrier reported better-than-expected earnings and raised its guidance, signaling to investors that CEO Dan Schulman’s overhaul is starting to pay off.  Verizon reported second-quarter adjusted earnings of $1.30 a share, as revenue slipped 0.7% from a year ago to $34.3 billion.  The telecommunications company also raised its full-year guidance.

items.title: T-Mobile’s Churn Problem: Why Great Earnings Can’t Mask Saturated Mobile Markets
items.summary: T-Mobile US  stock was sliding on Thursday after the wireless carrier reported softer-than-expected second-quarter revenue, overshadowing an earnings beat.  T-Mobile reported adjusted earnings of $2.99, as revenue climbed 7.9% from a year ago to $22.8 billion.  Analysts were expecting earnings of $2.54 a share on revenue of $22.9 billion, per a FactSet poll.
